snippet.title: NewCity - "A Pleasant Day in Pleasanton" - Steam Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
NewCity - The Regional Citybuilder
Steam Early Access is available now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1067860/NewCity/

NewCity is the flagship title from Lone Pine Games, a city builder that celebrates the simulation titles of yesteryear with classic gameplay and a fresh coat of paint.

Build prosperity for your citizens across generations as you build a thriving metropolis that stretches to the horizon. You’re the Mayor, and you lead your city with impunity. There are no councilmembers here—every decision, every victory and setback… it all comes down to you. Build your city from the ground up, rural town to metropolitan jewel, calling all the shots along the way.
